'''Fen'po''' was a [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomir Witch]] of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]]. She was present when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] uncovered the remains of the ''[[Chu'unthor]]''.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|263|Fen'po}}</ref>
